title: Eden requirements document
description: Product-tier (P) registry document (doc 11 §6): the project's requirement catalogue. Canonical form is YAML (`requirements.yaml`), wholly structured; prose fields are markdown strings. Extends the common envelope (doc 11 §4) and constrains it to the requirements type. As a product-tier document it must carry conversation grounding: `meta.source` is required (doc 11 §4, §2).

type.description: Selects this schema. MUST be the literal string `requirements`.

data.description: Structured requirement catalogue. The only content beyond the envelope; this document has no narrative `sections`.

items.description: The requirement records, one per requirement. At least one requirement must be present.

requirement.description: A single requirement record (item prefix REQ, doc 11 §3).

id.description: Stable requirement identifier of the form REQ-NNNN, e.g. REQ-0007 (doc 11 §3 grammar). Unique within the document; never reused or renumbered once assigned.

statement.description: The requirement itself, as a markdown prose field. Author in EARS style: WHEN <trigger> THE SYSTEM SHALL <response>; for state-driven requirements WHILE <state> THE SYSTEM SHALL <response>; for ubiquitous requirements THE SYSTEM SHALL <response>. EARS is recommended, not enforced, in v1 (doc 11 Q1).

kind.description: Requirement category. `functional` = a behaviour the system performs; `quality` = a non-functional/quality-attribute requirement (performance, security, usability, etc.); `constraint` = a design or implementation constraint the solution must respect.

priority.description: Delivery priority. P1 = must-have (gate-blocking coverage at Deliver, doc 11 §7 T6); P2 = should-have; P3 = nice-to-have.

rationale.description: Why this requirement exists — the need or constraint it answers — as a markdown prose field. Ties the statement back to product intent.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria: the verifiable conditions under which this requirement is satisfied. Each entry is a markdown prose field; at least one criterion is required.

links.description: Typed upstream edges for this requirement (doc 11 §3, §4): `realizes` upstream items it serves, `refines` a same-tier requirement, etc. Links point upstream only; reverse edges are derived by tooling.

source.description: Optional per-item conversation grounding: where in a transcript this specific requirement originated (same shape as `meta.source`, doc 11 §4). Use to attribute an individual requirement to a transcript span more precisely than the document-level source.

run.description: The Run id (02 §2) whose transcript produced this requirement.

span.description: The span within that transcript, e.g. "messages 12-31".
